_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Naglalar ka hin Golf (Card Game) - Player {player_id}.
Tuyo: Makakuha han pinakabababa nga total nga iskor ha ini nga usa ka round. Kon an mga column may pareho nga bili, ginsumahan hira komo 0.
Mga Bili han Kard: A=1, 2-10=face value, J/Q=10, K=0

Mga Aksyon (gamita an eksakto nga mga bracket):
- '[draw]' - Draw tikang ha deck
- '[take]' - Kuhai tikang ha discard pile
- '[swap X Y]' - Ipalit an drawn kard ha posisyon X (row) Y (column)
- '[discard]' - Iwaksi an drawn kard

board.drew:
Nag-draw ka: {card}
Kinahanglan ka [swap X Y] o [discard] it.
board.took:
Nakakuha ka: {card} tikang ha discard pile
Kinahanglan ka mag [swap X Y] ini (diri pwede magdiskartha).

options.final_turns: Final turns! Imo mga opsyon: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Kinahanglan mo: [swap X Y] (diri makakabantad hin mga kard tikang han ginkakawat nga kadamo)

hand.header: Col: 1 2 3 An mga tawo nga nag-uukoy ha Roma.

message.deck_empty: An deck waray na! Natatapos an dula dayon.
message.knocked: Player {pid} nag-knock! Kada iba nga player may usa pa ka turno.
message.final_round: Ang manugdula nga {pid} {reason}! Kada iba nga manugdula may usa pa ka turno.

reason.all_revealed: may ada tanan kartas na nabunyagan

invalid.wrong_action: Gamita an usa ka bracketed action: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], o [peek X Y]
invalid.must_draw_first: Kinahanglan ka muna mag [draw], [take], [knock], o [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Diri mo makukuha an kard nga ginkuha tikang ha tinigib, kinahanglan ibaylo ito.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Mayda ka nakakuha nga card. Kinahanglan ka mag [swap X Y] o [discard] ini.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Kinahanglan mo hin gin-iibanan nga kard basi magbaylo.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Kinahanglan mo hin gin-ihap nga kard basi makalikay.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Posisyon ha gawas han mga limit. Gamita an row 1-{max_row}, column 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Diri ka makakagtuktok nga may-ada ginkuha nga kard. Taposon anay an imo turno.
invalid.already_knocked: May-ada na nagpirma hini nga ronda.
